ideas.pitch: An AI-powered peer matching and trust platform specifically designed to connect women in tech for targeted mentorship and portfolio reviews, featuring automated scheduling and conversation prompts.
ideas.title: ElleMentor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses a community-driven problem familiar to organisers and attendees at a women-focused hackathon like ElleHacks, creating immediate emotional resonance with judges.

ideas.pitch: A crowdsourced and real-time safety monitoring mobile web app for public transit commuters in Toronto, allowing users to share verified route safety reports and coordinate buddy groups for late-night travel.
ideas.title: SafeTransit Toronto
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets local safety challenges faced directly by students and residents navigating Toronto during winter or late nights, presenting clear, measurable social impact.

ideas.pitch: An AI-driven nutritional and lifestyle tracking assistant tailored for women's hormonal health, delivering personalized meal and wellness plans based on cycle phase logging.
ideas.title: HealthHer AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Builds upon the proven success of specialized AI health assistants by tackling an underserved demographic gap in general wellness tech.

ideas.pitch: An automated auditing tool for company job postings that scans text for gender-biased language, non-inclusive requirements, and pay transparency gaps, suggesting immediate rewrites.
ideas.title: EquityScan
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines natural language processing with a clear economic and social benefit directed at workplace equality, appealing strongly to diversity-focused hackathon themes.

ideas.pitch: A transparent micro-grant platform utilizing decentralized escrow mechanics to fund grassroots community projects and initiatives led by women founders in Ontario.
ideas.title: LocalImpact DAO
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates practical blockchain integration with real-world financial transparency and regional focus, capturing attention if any sponsor tracks emerge.
